title: exam_item
description: One JLPT-style practice question, drawn from the corpus so every item is also findable in a lesson. The id prefix names the section, and each section has its own required shape.

x-yomineko.vocabulary_policy: Types, nesting and `required` are measured from the data. Value sets are not: every `enum` here is either declared in a design document, parsed from the code that produces the value, or curated in build_schemas.py with its source named in x-vocabulary. See contracts/README.md.

audio.description: The audio asset, or the literal `pending` while the TTS pipeline (design/listening.md) has not produced it yet. The first real filename must not fail the build.

review_status.description: Human review verdicts that are still LIVE for this record: each one's content hash still matches the text it approved. Written by the exporter from research/derived/review_ledger.json, never by hand — an entry whose text was rewritten afterwards is stale and exports nothing, and a review_status the ledger does not justify is a hard failure (scripts/validate/validate_review_ledger.py). Absent on a record nobody has reviewed, which is why it is never required. See design/review_ledger.md.

field.description: The reviewed field, or "*" for the whole record.

locale.description: The locale reviewed; null for a locale-agnostic verdict.

status.description: The verdict a named reviewer recorded. Vocabulary owner: design — design/review_ledger.md. Widening it is an edit there, never a side effect of regenerating this schema from the data.

reviewed_by.description: Who reviewed it. An anonymous approval is not a review, and the correction-rate metric is per person.

approved_at.description: When. Provenance and ordering only — approvals do not expire (APP_PLAN D4): a rewrite invalidates them, the calendar does not.

content_hash.description: The sha256 of exactly what was reviewed, so a reader can tell WHICH text was approved without the ledger.

speaker.description: Locale-neutral speaker slot the TTS pipeline maps to a voice. Vocabulary owner: design — design/listening.md (speaker registry — dialogue voices plus narrator). Widening it is an edit there, never a side effect of regenerating this schema from the data.

x-vocabulary.source: design/listening.md (speaker registry — dialogue voices plus narrator)

allOf.title: known section
allOf.description: Every item's id names one of the declared exam sections. A typo'd prefix would otherwise match no branch and be validated by the envelope alone.

allOf.title: word-level multiple choice
allOf.description: kanji_reading / orthography: a word in isolation, four options. Applies to ids prefixed kr, or (2371 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.

allOf.title: multiple choice inside a sentence
allOf.description: context_fill / grammar_form: the gap sits in a real corpus sentence. Applies to ids prefixed cf, gf (1719 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.

allOf.title: ordering
allOf.description: sentence_order: the learner rebuilds the sentence from shuffled pieces. Applies to ids prefixed so (871 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.

allOf.title: passage multiple choice
allOf.description: text_grammar / reading_comp: the item hangs off a reading passage, and the prompt is carried by `stem` or by `question` depending on the section. Applies to ids prefixed tg, rc (473 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.

allOf.title: paraphrase
allOf.description: paraphrase: pick the sentence that means the same thing. Applies to ids prefixed pp (182 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.

allOf.title: usage
allOf.description: usage: pick the sentence that uses the target word correctly. Applies to ids prefixed us (182 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.

allOf.title: listening
allOf.description: the five listening sections: a spoken script, its audio, and options. Applies to ids prefixed lt, lp, ls, lr, lg (239 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.
